####################################################################################################
Purpose: To tidy up and explore the metadata of GSK studies sourced from GSK
https://clinicalstudydatarequest.com/SearchAllPostings.aspx

Data:
- `studies_all`: Metadata of all GSK studies.

Output:
- `stu_meta_gsk.rds`: Data frame containing metadata of GSK studies with information on pathogens,
vaccines, study phase, study date, linked studies, and links to databases.
- `stu_meta_gsk_{x}.txt`: Data frame containing metadata of GSK studies per pathogen classification.
####################################################################################################

# Set wd to project directory
```{r setup}
rm(list = ls())
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = '~/Nextcloud/Projects/_seas_imm/code_exp_imm')
```

# Load packages, themes, directories, and functions
```{r}
source("00_pck.R")
```

# Load data 
```{r}
# Load data frame of requested and received studies
stu_req <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$processed}/stu_req.rds"))

# Load metadata of the studies (sourced from GSK)
stu_meta_gsk <- read_excel(glue("{dirs$raw}/studies_all.xls")) %>%
  # Fix column names
  set_names("post_id", "stu_spo", "stu_tit", "stu_vacc", "study", "nctid", "stu_pat", "tri_pha",
            "tri_link", "tri_link.gov", "tri_link.ct", "dat_ana_red", "rep_annotated", "rep_clin",
            "dat_speci", "prot_amen", "dat_raw", "rep_plan", "add", "date") %>%
  # Tidy study IDs
  mutate(study = str_remove(study, pattern = "GSK-"),
         study = gsub(" .*", "", study),
         study = case_when(study == "RTX114351" ~ "114351",
                           study == "V72P12" ~ "205399",
                           study == "V72P13E1" ~ "205453",
                           study == "V72P13" ~ "205450",
                           TRUE ~ as.character(study)),
         study = str_replace(study, "/", "-")) %>%
  # Filter only the requested files 
  filter(study %in% stu_req$study)

# Ensure no study is missing (should be 265 studies)
stopifnot(length(unique(stu_req$study)) == length(unique(stu_meta_gsk[[1]])))
length(unique(stu_req$study))
```

# Create tidy pathogen classification of the study (stu_pat_tidy)
```{r}
stu_meta_gsk <- stu_meta_gsk %>%
  # Create summarized classification column 
  mutate(
    stu_pat_tidy = tolower(stu_pat),
    stu_pat_tidy = case_when(stu_pat_tidy == "measles, mumps, rubella" ~ "measles; mumps; rubella",
                             .default = stu_pat_tidy)) %>%
  # Separate the column with grouped pathogens to tidy up names
  separate_longer_delim(stu_pat_tidy, delim = ";") %>%
  mutate(stu_pat_tidy = str_remove_all(stu_pat_tidy, " |,")) %>%
  mutate(stu_pat_tidy = case_when(
    stu_pat_tidy %in% c("infectionsstreptococcal") ~ "strep",
    stu_pat_tidy %in% c("acellularpertussis", "wholecellpertussis") ~ "pertussis",
    stu_pat_tidy %in% c("hepatitisb") ~ "hbv",
    stu_pat_tidy %in% c("poliomyelitis") ~ "polio",
    stu_pat_tidy %in% c("haemophilusinfluenzaetypeb") ~ "hib",
    stu_pat_tidy %in% c("neisseriameningitidis", "infectionsmeningococcal", 
                        "meningococcaldisease") ~ "men",
    stu_pat_tidy %in% c("infectionsrotavirus") ~ "rota",
    stu_pat_tidy %in% c("hepatitisa") ~ "hav",
    stu_pat_tidy %in% c("varicella") ~ "vzv",
    .default = stu_pat_tidy)) %>%
  group_by(across(c(-stu_pat_tidy))) %>%
  # Mark combined vaccines (MMR, DTP)
  mutate(
    mmr = any(stu_pat_tidy == "measles") & any(stu_pat_tidy == "mumps") & any(stu_pat_tidy == "rubella"),
    dtp = any(stu_pat_tidy == "diphtheria") & any(stu_pat_tidy == "tetanus") & any(stu_pat_tidy == "pertussis")) %>%
  mutate(stu_pat_tidy = case_when(
    stu_pat_tidy %in% c("measles", "mumps", "rubella") & mmr == TRUE ~ "mmr",
    stu_pat_tidy %in% c("diphtheria", "tetanus", "pertussis") & dtp == TRUE ~ "dtp",
    .default = stu_pat_tidy)) %>%
  select(-c(mmr, dtp)) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  # Arrange alphabetically
  arrange(study, stu_pat_tidy) %>%
  # Create the column with grouped pathogens
  summarise(stu_pat_tidy = str_c(stu_pat_tidy, collapse = "_")) %>%
  ungroup()

# Summarize the number of studies per pathogen classification
stu_meta_gsk %>%
  group_by(stu_pat_tidy) %>%
  summarise(n())
```

# Save the tidy metadata
```{r}
# Save the complete tidy metadata as an RDS file
saveRDS(stu_meta_gsk, file = glue("{dirs$processed}/stu_meta_gsk.rds"))

# Save the tidy metadata for each pathogen classification group as text files
lapply(unique(stu_meta_gsk$stu_pat_tidy), function(x) {
  write.table(filter(stu_meta_gsk, stu_pat_tidy == x), sep = "\t",
              file = glue("{dirs$processed}/00_meta_gsk/stu_meta_gsk_{x}.txt"))
  return(filter(stu_meta_gsk, stu_pat_tidy == x))
})
```

# Exploratory plots ================================================================================
 
## Columns with data unique or shared by all the studies
Columns unique (ids):
- post_id: Post identifier
- stu_id: Study identifier (preferred)

Columns shared by all the studies: 
- stu_spo: GSK sponsor
- dat_speci: Datasets with specifications
- dat_raw: Raw data available
```{r}
# Check number of unique values per column
stu_meta_gsk %>%
  summarise(across(everything(),~length(unique(.x)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), values_to = "unique")

# Eliminate columns that do not add significant information
stu_meta_gsk <- stu_meta_gsk %>%
  select(-c(post_id, stu_spo, dat_speci, dat_raw))
```

# Studies pathogens 
There are 19 pathogen groups
```{r}
# Frequency of pathogen groups 
pat_g <- stu_meta_gsk %>%
  group_by(stu_pat_tidy) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  arrange(n)

# Plot frequency
pl_g <- pat_g %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = n, y = reorder(stu_pat_tidy,n), fill = reorder(stu_pat_tidy,n)))+
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") + 
    scale_y_discrete("") + 
  scale_x_continuous("Number of studies", expand = c(0,0), limits = c(0,50)) + 
    scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "magma", direction = -1) + 
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    ggtitle("Total studies per pathogen")
print(pl_g)
```

There are 14 pathogens (regardless of groups)
```{r}
# Frequency of pathogen individually 
pat_i <- pat_g %>%
  mutate(stu_pat_tidy = str_replace(stu_pat_tidy, "dtp", "d_t_p"),
         stu_pat_tidy = str_replace(stu_pat_tidy, "mmr", "me_mu_r")) %>%
  separate_longer_delim(stu_pat_tidy, delim = "_") %>%
  group_by(stu_pat_tidy) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(n)) %>%
  arrange(-n)

# Plot frequency
pl_i <- pat_i %>%
  mutate(stu_pat_tidy = factor(
    stu_pat_tidy,
    levels = c("hbv","t","p", "d", "hib", "polio","strep", "men", "r", "mu", "me", "rota", 
               "vzv", "hav"),
    labels = c("Hepatitis B virus", "Clostridium tetani", "Bordetella pertussis", "Corynebacterium diphtheriae", 
               "Haemophilus influenza type B", "Poliovirus", "Streptococcus pneumoniae", "Neisseria meningitidis", 
               "Rubella virus", "Mumps virus", "Measles virus", "Rotavirus", 
               "Varicella Zoster Virus", "Hepatitis A virus"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = n, y = reorder(stu_pat_tidy,n), fill = reorder(stu_pat_tidy,n)))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") + 
  scale_y_discrete(" ") + 
  scale_x_continuous("Number of studies", expand = c(0,0), limits = c(0,100)) + 
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "magma", direction = -1) + 
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  ggtitle("Total studies per pathogen")
print(pl_i)
```

# Studies vaccines
```{r}
vac_g <- stu_meta_gsk %>%
  group_by(stu_pat_tidy) %>%
  mutate(stu_pat_n = n()) %>%
  group_by(stu_vacc, stu_pat_tidy, stu_pat_n) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  arrange(stu_pat_tidy)
  
vac_g %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(stu_pat_tidy) %>%
  summarise(stu_vacc_n = n()) %>%
  arrange(-stu_vacc_n)

pl_v <- vac_g %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = stu_vacc, x = n, fill = reorder(stu_pat_tidy, -stu_pat_n))) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  facet_grid(reorder(stu_pat_tidy, -stu_pat_n)~., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "magma") + 
  theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0), 
        legend.position = "none")
print(pl_v)
```

# Other preliminary information from the studies 
```{r}
pl_o <- stu_meta_gsk %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(tri_pha, dat_ana_red, rep_annotated, 
                        rep_clin, prot_amen, rep_plan)) %>%
  mutate(name = case_when(name == "tri_pha" ~ "Phase",
                          name == "dat_ana_red" ~ "Analysis-ready dataset",
                          name == "rep_annotated" ~ "Annotated case report form",
                          name == "rep_clin" ~ "Clinical study report",
                          name == "prot_amen" ~ "Protocol with any amendments",
                          name == "rep_plan" ~ "Reporting and analysis plan")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = value)) +
  geom_bar() + 
  scale_y_discrete("") + 
  facet_wrap(name~., scales = "free_y")
print(pl_o)
```

## Date of the RCTs (it is not the data of the rct, but date of introduction to database)
```{r}
stu_meta_gsk %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date)) +
  geom_bar()
```

## Clinical trials information
There are 31 studies that share the clinical trial id and link.   
```{r}
stu_meta_gsk %>%
  group_by(tri_link.gov, nctid) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  filter(n > 1) %>%
  arrange(-n) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(sum(n) - 76)
```

# Plot
```{r}
wrap_elements((pl_g / pl_i) | pl_v) + wrap_elements(pl_o) + plot_layout(heights = c(1,0.5), ncol = 1)
```
